predictions.quote: The US is forecasted to increase its electricity production capacity from 1 to 2 terowatt by 2040 15 years from now. During that same period of time, China is going to go from 3 to 8 terowatt.
predictions.prediction: By 2040, US electricity production capacity will roughly double from 1 to 2 terawatts, while China's capacity will roughly grow from 3 to 8 terawatts over the same period.
